entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is an official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for user, session, and agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database functions as an official Hermes Agent provider by organizing data into a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system (Abstract, Overview, and Details) to achieve significant token reduction and improved task completion rates.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for AI agents across more than 25 LLM providers. It offers multi-language client implementations and has achieved state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that builds persistent memory from text, code, and conversations. It distills session lessons into searchable permanent memory and supports local extraction models that do not require LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent provider, Supermemory features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at high scale. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources including PDFs, images, and video.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: GBrain is an opinionated agent brain that combines keyword retrieval, semantic search, and a typed knowledge graph for synthesis with citations. It exposes memory to agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) over local or Tailscale connections.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents and serves as the upstream foundation for the Hermes-specific self-hosted wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and integrates with MCP, Claude Code, and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that uses a single SQLite database for local storage. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports integrations with OpenWebUI and MCP.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os implements a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agents using local infrastructure like Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that provides filesystem-first artifacts such as traces, playbooks, and context bundles. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes-LCM is a Lossless Context Management plugin that uses a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for recovering specific details from its SQLite store.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool automatically indexes history from 35 different coding agents, including Claude Code and Cursor, to enable searching through months of past sessions. It provides MCP-based recall at session start or via tool calls while redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider for flexible infrastructure integration.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur serves as a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent portability. It utilizes an MCP server to provide hybrid retrieval through a combination of BM25 and local embeddings.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity and secrets layer that syncs memory across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses with 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy. The system supports real-time ingestion from external sources including Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates without cloud dependencies or API keys, using a local GGUF observer model to capture session decisions. It combines BM25, vector search, and cross-encoder reranking to manage retrieval entirely on the user's hardware.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a five-package plugin family that provides durable, file-based memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. The architecture is notable for requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models to function.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long-context inference by reordering text and multimodal context for prefix-cache sharing. It integrates with vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp to provide deduplication and cache-aware scheduling for Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result and tracking contradictions in the data. It features a self-directing loop for gap identification and uses recency ranking to maintain memory relevance.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses a user's Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis featuring citations, links, and provenance for persistent knowledge across sessions. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets. The system manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory using a combination of BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for diverse sources like codebases and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed layer provides durable context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex by storing information in plain Markdown files. It manages updates through a system of hash-checked proposals and receipts to ensure reviewed context synchronization.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that enables real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It features an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking every memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families like EVM and Solana. It allows for budget-bound agent wallets and operates without the need for a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to facilitate capability routing and knowledge retrieval. It supports neighbor traversal and uses detached model calls for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Focusing on cross-session continuity, this provider uses native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots. It employs a local SQLite layer for reliable caching and allows agents to read memories generated by other connected agents.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for searching, syncing, and reading files.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution that features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN and FM-index. It supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes, incorporating MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve agent state.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies stale information and contradictions within agent memory using specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs from plain markdown files, allowing users to track and revert memory changes through a local git repository.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It functions as a software development methodology that integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime via DeepSeek Harness. It enables agents to export prototypes into formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to provide standardized cybersecurity capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layout changes and includes an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It adds a verification and dispute resolution layer to natural-language mandates and official protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Compatible with Hermes and Claude Code, this tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns across five voice profiles. It supports distinct modes for rewriting, detection, and editing in place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos for platforms like Hermes and Codex. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent without telemetry or user accounts. It provides ready-to-paste exports for assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin grants Hermes Agent the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract video transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with other agents like OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, managed via dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It uses a CLI-driven mechanism kernel to manage work, decisions, and evidence.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production and automation in Portuguese. It supports integrations for communication platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These developer tools follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. Supported integrations include CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation prompting. It integrates with the BFL API to support polling, webhooks, and the FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines. It features automated workflows for briefing, creating, testing, and exporting these skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that compiles natural language into reviewable files using a deterministic compiler. It ensures execution integrity through verified traces and supports multiple AI model providers.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills that can be installed via a Python client or CLI with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features through TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification, this hub facilitates autonomous skill browsing and one-click installation. It operates 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token consumption and maintains functionality through graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling and habit management. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial analysis and edge-case detection. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection adds persistent memory to agent sessions and provides tools for worktree recovery and skill scaffolding. It orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes commands for multi-session reconciliation and evaluation auditing.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs .tape or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal interfaces and web apps, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. Proposed updates are gated behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators to prevent regressions without requiring external services.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while monitoring official specifications to detect field drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This collection provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment for agentskills.io compliant clients. It includes an MCP server that facilitates browser-based OAuth authentication and workspace Postgres integration.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos into Markdown, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and refining Chinese AI-generated text. It is designed for content workflows, including an E-commerce Material Studio for structured data extraction.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures agents can correctly route file operations and verify compatible runtimes without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and the OpenClaw ecosystem for programmatic financial transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This tool certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows Hermes Agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties and managing boards, with payments distributed automatically upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests while producing structured analysis that includes core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a structured debate format between bullish and bearish researchers, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents who approve final trades.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration platform that governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, supporting both local Node.js and Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent background execution using tmux and provides secure sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms supported by durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage and visualize agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task statuses and a live stream of agent reasoning and tool execution. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, and infrastructure roles. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles through a integrated Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code, specifically orchestrating TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It manages structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to optimize agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack that uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing files. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure data remains current.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, via a Terminal User Interface. It allows developers to visualize their consumption and optionally submit data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget monitors real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and over 40 other AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides historical breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It features 36 distinct skills for deployment and monitoring, operating autonomously while requiring founder approval for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-created themes and skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art through a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This social economy platform enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging and register human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through a supervisor sidebar that manages approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that scans agent configurations and system prompts for schema mismatches or contradictory directions. It supports HERM v1.1 scoring and exports findings in formats like SARIF and GitLab Code Quality.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code to enhance agent memory.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining unique local tools and instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It enables zero-cost operation using free models and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping configurations, credentials, and memory archives into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles the transfer of SOUL.md and skills while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco offers self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It detects performance drift using config-aware baselines and supports both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue through Hermes Agent, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It enforces a strict security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake word support and adaptive turn-taking. It functions without API keys or accounts, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin enables multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for Hermes Agent via the MemOS API. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling configurations across multiple agents including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It allows users to perform one-click switching between different API providers within a single interface.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with file access and user approval for agents like Hermes and OpenClaw. It extends accessibility by providing remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface offers 1:1 feature parity with the Hermes CLI for use on web browsers and mobile devices. It utilizes a three-panel layout for chat, sessions, and workspace browsing, built entirely with Python and vanilla JavaScript.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app facilitates the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent via local backends or remote API connections. It features a streaming chat UI with markdown support and provides management for 14 toolsets, memory systems, and environment profiles.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: This web dashboard serves as a unified configuration hub for Hermes and other runtimes across ten communication platforms like WhatsApp and Matrix. It includes a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent coordination. The interface integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated inspector panel for managing skills and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes and Codex, as a desktop or self-hosted application. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote connectivity.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs through an embedded terminal.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The UI supports memory management and LaTeX rendering while providing native window and process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes using intelligent tab-scoping controls. It features site-aware drafting capabilities in 31 writing environments and supports multi-agent thread synchronization.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details, file attachments, and private push notifications via an open-source relay.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code alongside custom LLM model routing. It provides a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency while monitoring live code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It builds a local search index without telemetry to track per-session token burn and estimated API-equivalent costs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication with cloud-based agents.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports profile and skill management alongside a kanban board for organizing agentic work and tasks.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard runs locally as a Telegram Mini App with dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and includes a terminal chat with file attachment support.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install desktop solution for Windows runs via portable Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks including TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
